description: Finds retry amplification and timeout blowups in Python codebases.
notes: Complete and validated: 85 tests pass; run against psf/requests (dae7ef6), openai/openai-python (d7c41ef) and PrefectHQ/prefect (d82220b) with numbers recorded in PROGRESS.md and the project README.
